name: Public documents (synthetic questions)
description: IRS 2025 and 2026 releases (tax inflation adjustments, retirement limits, mileage rates) and the RAGSeal guide; nine documents searched together.
data_note: Every question here is synthetic: written by the judge model from an exact quote and kept only after automatic validation (quote verbatim, answer inside the quote). None is human-labelled; a held-back sample is listed in ../SYNTHETIC_SPOT_CHECK.md for people to check.
license: IRS newsroom releases are U.S. government works (public domain). RAGSeal documents are this project's own.
risk_rules: Never quote a 2025 figure when the question asks about 2026.

test_cases.question: In RAGSeal, which judge model is used as a fallback when all hosted judges have used up their rate limit?

gold.quote: If every hosted judge has used up its rate limit, a live question falls back to the local qwen3:8b judge, and the result says so.
